title: Japan Koyo Trails
tagline: Red maples, quiet temples and a bullet train to Kyoto.
whyYoullLoveIt: Timed for peak autumn colour, with a night in a Hakone onsen ryokan and Kyoto's temples lit up after dark.
summary: Nine days from Tokyo to Osaka in koyo season, when Japan's maples turn red and gold. You'll see Fuji across Lake Kawaguchiko, soak in a Hakone hot spring, ride the Shinkansen and walk Kyoto's temple gardens at their most beautiful, with an Indian Tour Manager handling every detail.
priceNote: Per person on twin sharing, with return flights from Mumbai. GST and TCS extra.

highlights.title: Peak koyo, twice
highlights.detail: Departures are timed for red maples in Nikko and Kyoto, when the leaves are at their best.

highlights.title: A night in a Hakone ryokan
highlights.detail: Tatami rooms, a private hot-spring bath and a nine-course kaiseki dinner.

highlights.title: Shinkansen to Kyoto

highlights.title: Fuji through the maples

itinerary.title: Konnichiwa, Tokyo
itinerary.description: Land at Narita and meet your Indian Tour Manager. A private coach takes you into the city for an evening walk under the lights of Shinjuku and a welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Old Tokyo, new Tokyo
itinerary.description: Senso-ji temple and Nakamise street in Asakusa, then the ginkgo avenue at Jingu Gaien turning gold. Afternoon at teamLab Planets, evening at the Shibuya Crossing.

itinerary.title: The maples of Nikko
itinerary.description: A day in the mountains for peak colour: the gilded Toshogu shrine, Kegon Falls and the 48 hairpin bends of the Irohazaka road, lined with red maples.

itinerary.title: Fuji, framed in red
itinerary.description: Coach to the Fuji Five Lakes. Walk the Momiji Corridor at Lake Kawaguchiko, ride up to the Fuji 5th Station (weather permitting) and sleep where Fuji fills the window.

itinerary.title: Hot springs and a pirate ship
itinerary.description: Cruise Lake Ashi, ride the Hakone Ropeway over the steaming vents of Owakudani and try a black egg. Tonight: a ryokan, a yukata, an onsen and kaiseki.

itinerary.title: Bullet train to Kyoto
itinerary.description: Shinkansen from Odawara to Kyoto. Afternoon among the thousand vermilion gates of Fushimi Inari, then an evening walk through Gion's lantern-lit lanes.

itinerary.title: Kyoto in colour
itinerary.description: Arashiyama's bamboo grove and the Tenryu-ji garden, the Golden Pavilion, then a private tea ceremony. After dark, Kiyomizu-dera's autumn illumination.

itinerary.title: Deer, a giant Buddha and street food
itinerary.description: Morning in Nara with the bowing deer and the Great Buddha of Todai-ji. On to Osaka Castle, then a street-food walk along Dotonbori.

itinerary.title: Sayonara
itinerary.description: A last browse along Shinsaibashi, then your transfer to Kansai Airport for the flight home.

title: Lapland Aurora Nights
tagline: Glass igloos, husky trails and a sky that moves.
whyYoullLoveIt: Three nights of aurora chances, two of them in a glass igloo where you can watch the sky from bed.
summary: A week above the Arctic Circle in deep winter. Husky sleds through silent forest, a snowmobile across frozen lakes, and two nights in a glass igloo in Saariselkä. The Northern Lights are never guaranteed, so we give you three nights of chances with guides who know where the clear skies are.
priceNote: Per person on twin sharing, with return flights from Mumbai. GST and TCS extra.
